NADIA BRENNAN-AZIZ
Senior Platform Engineer | Cloud Infrastructure / SRE
Manchester, UK | nadia.brennanaziz@example.com | +44 7700 900909 | github.com/nba-sre-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior platform and SRE engineer with 10 years of infrastructure experience, including six years running Kubernetes platforms on AWS. Builds dependable cloud infrastructure and paved roads for product teams through self-service platforms, infrastructure as code, observability, and practical incident processes. Technical lead with a record of improving deployment speed, service reliability, and infrastructure cost.

EXPERIENCE

Senior Platform Engineer - Tallybrook Ltd (B2B accounting SaaS), Manchester / remote | Apr 2022 - Present
- Technical lead of the five-person platform team, operating an EKS platform with 8 clusters, approximately 350 services, and 3 regions.
- Built an internal developer platform adopted by all 14 product teams: Go and Python service templates, Argo CD ApplicationSets, and Crossplane compositions for self-service RDS, SQS, and S3.
- Reduced time from new service to production from approximately 2 weeks to under 1 day.
- Led migration from cluster-autoscaler managed node groups to Karpenter, using Spot instances for stateless workloads; reduced EC2 spend by 38% (about GBP 410k per year).
- Introduced SLOs, burn-rate alerts, and error budget policies for the 20 most critical services in partnership with product leadership; reduced on-call pages per week by approximately 60%.
- Participate in the incident commander rotation and wrote the incident and post-mortem process.

Site Reliability Engineer - Brightwater Games, Leeds | Jan 2019 - Mar 2022
- Operated AWS game backend infrastructure for titles with up to 1.2 million daily active players, across EC2, ECS, and EKS.
- Managed AWS infrastructure in Terraform using approximately 40 modules, with Atlantis for pull-request plan and apply workflows.
- Replaced a noisy Nagios setup with Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager, and Loki.
- Load-tested with k6 and planned launch capacity; a test simulating 300,000 concurrent players exposed a connection-pool limit that was fixed before launch.

Linux Systems Engineer - Pennine Hosting, Sheffield | Jul 2016 - Dec 2018
- Managed approximately 600 Linux servers for hosting customers using Puppet configuration management.
- Automated operational tasks with Bash and Python and provided on-call support for customer incidents.

EDUCATION
BSc Computer Science, University of the North Moors | 2016

CERTIFICATIONS
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) | 2021, renewed 2024
AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional | 2023

SKILLS
Cloud infrastructure: AWS, EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS, S3, SQS, Route 53, CloudFront
Infrastructure as code and configuration: Terraform, Atlantis, Puppet
Kubernetes and platform engineering: Kubernetes, Helm, Kustomize, Argo CD, Crossplane, Karpenter
Observability and reliability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager, OpenTelemetry, SLOs, error budgets, incident management
Programming and testing: Go, Python, Bash, k6
CI/CD: GitHub Actions

ADDITIONAL
Speaker, UK DevOps meetup (2024): “SLOs that product managers care about”
Mentored three engineers transitioning from backend development into SRE
Languages: English (native), Urdu (conversational)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor role at Corvale Mobility. The opportunity to help shape the cloud infrastructure connecting a new generation of trains with backend services, and take it from design into production, closely matches my experience building and operating AWS platforms for services that need to be reliable at scale.

At Tallybrook, I am technical lead of a five-person platform team operating EKS across three regions. I built an internal developer platform adopted by all 14 product teams, combining Go and Python service templates, Argo CD, and Crossplane-based self-service infrastructure. This reduced the path from a new service to production from around two weeks to under a day. I have also led infrastructure improvements with measurable operational and cost outcomes, including a 38% reduction in EC2 spend through Karpenter and Spot instances.

My earlier role at Brightwater Games gave me hands-on experience with Terraform-managed AWS infrastructure, observability, and launch readiness for game backends serving up to 1.2 million daily active players. I used k6 load testing to identify a connection-pool limit before a launch, and replaced noisy Nagios alerting with Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager, and Loki. At Tallybrook, I introduced SLOs and burn-rate alerts with product leadership, reducing on-call pages by about 60% for the services in scope.

I would bring Corvale practical experience in cloud infrastructure design and operation, Terraform, system reliability, and leading technical work with product teams. My AWS experience includes VPC and IAM; I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how this background could contribute to the train-to-cloud platform.

Best wishes,
Nadia Brennan-Aziz
